users.admin_required: Sign in as an administrator to manage user accounts, groups, mounted shares, and audit logs.
users.user_created_toast: User account and personal home folder created.
users.delete_user_confirm: Permanently delete account "@{username}"? (Files inside their home folder are preserved.)
users.sessions_hint: Monitor and remotely revoke devices currently signed in.
users.oidc_auto_create_label: Auto-provision local account on first SSO login
users.outbox_empty: No messages recorded in the local outbox yet.
settings.perms_cascade_hint: Permission cascade for public gallery & global capabilities: Role → Group overrides (Deny wins) → User overrides. Private homes (users/) and shares remain strictly governed by their ACLs.
settings.desktop_template_desc: Your administrator desktop is isolated from the public desktop. Use this panel to manage shortcuts displayed to anonymous visitors and inherited by new accounts.
settings.desktop_template_publish_btn: Publish my current desktop as global template
settings.desktop_template_empty: No shortcuts in the global template.
account.export_desc: Generate a signed, time-limited download link containing all your personal files and account metadata. After the full download completes, confirm receipt to immediately purge the archive from the server.
account.export_ready_toast: Signed ZIP archive is ready for download.
account.export_receipt_confirmed_toast: Full receipt confirmed: temporary archive purged from server.
account.delete_warning: Warning: deleting your account is permanent and irreversible. All files in your personal home folder, preferences, shares, and active sessions will be permanently erased from the server.
account.delete_with_export_label: Generate a signed ZIP backup link (valid for the duration selected above) before deletion
account.delete_irreversible_check: I understand that deleting my account and files is permanent and irreversible.
account.delete_final_confirm: Permanently delete account @{username} and all its stored data?
account.deleted_success_toast: Your account has been permanently deleted.
account.deleted_export_modal_desc: Your account has been deleted. Your backup archive remains downloadable via this signed link until expiration or until you confirm complete receipt.
storage.mounts_desc: Mount a WebDAV drive (Nextcloud, Synology, kDrive), S3/R2/MinIO bucket, or Google Drive as a native volume in Explorer and VFS Bridge. Credentials are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM).
storage.trash_desc: Deleted items are kept for 30 days before automatic permanent purge.
storage.driver_s3_sub: Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, MinIO, B2
storage.field_volume_name_hint: Friendly label shown in Explorer and on the Desktop (e.g. My Google Drive, Home NAS).
storage.webdav_guide: Enter your WebDAV endpoint URL. If 2FA is enabled on your server, generate a dedicated application password.
storage.webdav_lan_label: Allow local network address (LAN / private NAS)
storage.webdav_lan_hint: Check only if your server is hosted on 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x, or an internal LAN hostname.
storage.s3_guide: Works with Cloudflare R2, AWS S3, MinIO, Scaleway, and Backblaze B2 via native AWS SigV4 signing.
storage.s3_endpoint_hint: Leave empty for standard AWS S3. Required for Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Scaleway, or B2.
storage.gdrive_guide_step1: In Google Cloud Console (APIs & Services → Credentials → Web OAuth Client ID), enable "Google Drive API" and add the redirect URI below.
storage.gdrive_guide_step2: Enter your Client ID & Client Secret below, then click "Connect with Google Drive" (tokens are retrieved and encrypted automatically).
storage.gdrive_server_client_ok: Server Google OAuth2 client detected: you can click "Connect with Google Drive" directly.
storage.gdrive_redirect_uri_label: Authorized redirect URI (copy into Google Cloud):
storage.gdrive_root_hint: Keep "root" for your entire Drive, or paste a specific folder ID from its URL (…/folders/<ID>).
storage.gdrive_manual_toggle: Advanced: enter existing OAuth2 tokens manually
storage.gdrive_manual_hint: Only needed if you already obtained tokens externally (e.g. OAuth Playground). Otherwise use the sign-in button above.
storage.gdrive_popup_blocked: Browser blocked the popup window: please allow popups for this site.
storage.local_guide: Mounts an existing folder on the server disk (e.g. external drive or NFS/SMB mount). Administrators only.
storage.local_path_hint: E.g. /mnt/nas/photos on Linux or D:\Media on Windows.
ext_apps.defaults_desc: Your preferred application per file extension (synced to your account). You can also click ☆ in Explorer's right-click "Open with" menu.
ext_apps.defaults_empty: No custom file associations yet: Atelier's automatic selection is active.
ext_apps.manager_desc: Deploy standalone HTML5/WASM web apps into apps/external/ via ZIP upload or direct URL, check upstream GitHub releases with explicit admin approval, and customize overrides.
ext_apps.empty_list: No standalone external web app detected.
ext_apps.uninstall_confirm: Uninstall external app "{name}"? Its folder will be permanently deleted.
ext_apps.reload_hint: Reload the page to refresh launcher menus and file associations.
ext_apps.enter_url_error: Please enter a valid ZIP archive URL.
dav.title: WebDAV Gateway (/dav/) & App Passwords
dav.desc: Mount your Atelier cloud as a native network drive in Windows Explorer, macOS Finder, Nautilus/Dolphin, or mobile apps using a dedicated revocable App Password (2FA-friendly).
dav.secret_once_notice: Copy this password now: it will never be shown again.
jobs.title: Async Background Jobs (bin/worker.php)
jobs.desc: SQLite background task queue (thumbnails, file index, large ZIP builds, FFmpeg video previews, ClamAV scan, backups). Processed automatically by Docker/cron worker or manually below.
backups.title: Automated Instance Backups
backups.desc: Create protected ZIP snapshots (storage/backups/) bundling the SQLite database, JSON settings, and SHA-256 manifest (with or without media files).
ai.login_required: Sign in to your account to configure your LLM profiles and AI Agent preferences.
ai.disabled_by_admin: The AI Agent is currently disabled for your account by the administrator.
ai.profiles_desc: Configure one or more providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, Mistral, or local Ollama / LM Studio). Your API keys are encrypted at rest (AES-256-GCM) and never leave the server.
ai.lan_enabled_notice: Private LAN endpoints (e.g. local Ollama / vLLM) are allowed by the administrator.
ai.lan_disabled_notice: Only public HTTPS endpoints are allowed (private LAN disabled by admin anti-SSRF policy).
ai.api_key_placeholder: sk-… (leave empty for keyless local Ollama)
ai.key_keep_hint: leave empty to keep stored key
ai.no_profiles: No personal LLM profile configured yet. Add a provider above or use the shared instance provider if enabled.
ai.vision_label: Allow sending canvas screenshots to multimodal models
ai.system_prompt_placeholder: E.g. Keep answers concise. Prefer clean structured formulas in GridCraft…
ai.apps_scope_label: Applications accessible to the AI Agent (native, games, and external WASM):
ai.admin_policy_desc: Control global AI Agent availability, private LAN SSRF policy (Ollama/vLLM), allowed domains, rate limits, and an optional shared provider for all users.
ai.admin_enabled_label: Enable AI Agent on this instance
ai.admin_allow_lan_label: Allow private LAN endpoints (Ollama / LM Studio / vLLM)
ai.help_ssrf_title: Local/LAN connection blocked by SSRF policy
ai.help_ssrf_desc: To reach a local server (Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM), an administrator must enable 'Allow private LAN endpoints' in the Admin AI Policy card below.
ai.help_openai: Create an OpenAI API key (sk-…) in OpenAI Platform → API Keys, then paste it above before testing.
ai.help_anthropic: Generate an Anthropic key (sk-ant-…) in Anthropic Console → Settings → API Keys, then paste it above.
ai.help_gemini: Create a Google Gemini API key in Google AI Studio → Get API Key, then paste it above.
ai.help_openrouter: Create an OpenRouter key (sk-or-…) in OpenRouter → Keys (/models discovery also works without a key).
ai.help_mistral: Generate a Mistral AI key in Mistral Console (console.mistral.ai) → API Keys, then paste it above.
ai.help_ollama: Ollama runs keyless on http://127.0.0.1:11434 (or your LAN NAS IP). Make sure an admin enables 'Allow private LAN endpoints'.
ai.help_openai_compat: Enter your OpenAI-compatible API base URL (e.g. LM Studio, vLLM, Scaleway) and Bearer token if required.
explorer_settings.click_card_desc: Choose how Explorer responds when clicking a file or folder.
explorer_settings.click_double_desc: Single-click selects the item (ideal for Space Quick Look, F2, Delete, and Inspector); double-click opens it.
explorer_settings.click_single_desc: Single-click opens the file or folder immediately. Use Ctrl/Shift or checkboxes to select items.
explorer_settings.default_view_label: Default view profile (when a folder has no saved view override)
explorer_settings.sidebar_auto: Automatic per profile (shown in Pro/Thumbnails, hidden in Multimedia)
explorer_settings.unified_folders_label: Show folders first inside the unified table (Pro List mode)
explorer_settings.show_checkboxes_label: Show selection checkboxes column in the table (Pro List mode)
explorer_settings.open_inspector_label: Automatically open the side Inspector on launch
explorer_settings.nav_cache_label: Enable instant navigation cache (automatically invalidated on file changes)
explorer_settings.folder_overrides_info: {count} folder(s) currently have a custom saved view mode.
